Git Tracker is a professional version control companion designed to keep you at the forefront of the software you rely on. By monitoring official GitHub releases, it provides a streamlined experience for tracking updates, reviewing changelogs, and managing assets for the projects you care about most.

• **Precision Syncing**: Robust background monitoring with intelligent rate-limit handling.
• **Enriched Documentation**: Full access to release notes and rendered READMEs, available offline.
• **Global Discovery**: Search and discover new repositories through direct GitHub API integration.
• **Native Experience**: A high-performance, Material 3 interface optimized for all Android form factors.
• **Data Portability**: Full support for importing and exporting your repository lists as standard JSON.
